mechanism.cost_hurdle: observed sweep displacement per share covers current spread plus exact entry and exit taker fees
mechanism.sizing: min($10 / arrival ask, 20% of displayed arrival ask size)
mechanism.exit: executable full-size bid markout at 1s, 2s, 5s and 10s
